raw.rationale: The presence of bilateral ventriculomegaly, irregular ventricular walls, and multiple hyperechoic regions within the ventricular lumens, along with areas of high signal intensity on T1-weighted images and low signal intensity on T2-weighted images on fetal MRI, are consistent with congenital CMV infection, which can cause these characteristic neuroimaging findings.

rejected.label: Congenital Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: While congenital toxoplasmosis can cause similar neuroimaging findings, the comprehensive workup, including a TORCH panel, returned within normal limits, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Dandy-Walker Malformation
rejected.why: Dandy-Walker malformation typically presents with hypoplasia of the cerebellar vermis and cystic dilation of the fourth ventricle, which were not described in the provided neuroimaging findings.

rejected.label: Lissencephaly
rejected.why: Lissencephaly is characterized by a smooth brain surface and thickened cortex, which were not mentioned in the neuroimaging findings.

rejected.label: Aicardi Syndrome
rejected.why: Aicardi syndrome typically presents with agenesis of the corpus callosum, choroid plexus papilloma, and other characteristic features not described in the provided case.
